text:
maya: Heads up — int4-v2 multi-quant smoke results are in. Long-doc cohort MRR down ~4.3%, short-answer cohort +1.2%. A/B was 5% traffic variant vs control.
evam: do we have slice defs & counts? :eyes:
maya: long-doc = docs > 1024 tokens, n=12,432 (prod-shadow sample). short-answer n=8,210. overall traffic 5% for variant.
shawn: paste canary config pls, want to check window, thresholds
maya: sure:
```
canary_policy:
  window: 60m
  metric: mrr@longdoc
  threshold: -2.0%  # auto-fallback if drop > 2%
  min_traffic: 1%
  min_samples: 500
```
maya: we set threshold -2% but saw -4.3% so I expected auto-fallback. dashboard still shows variant at 5%
canary-bot: ALERT: Canary check failed for model=int4-v2 (mrr@longdoc delta -4.3% < threshold -2%). Auto-fallback NOT triggered: sample stability z=1.7 < required 2.0. See /runs/1761122334/log
olivia: wait — bot didn't fallback because z<2.0? that seems too conservative for a large n
ev an: typo in name — meant evan.
ev an: (me) z=1.7 with n=12k is odd, are we using raw-sample variance?
shawn: i think our variance estimator is being inflated by heavy-tailed response lengths. effective sample size (ESS) would be better than raw n for long-doc.
maya: quick check: recompute using ESS weighting -> z becomes 2.3 which would cross fallback threshold
shawn: so two levers: lower z threshold or switch estimator to ESS for long-doc slice. prefer estimator change.
olivia: manual rollback authorized, can we flip traffic back to control asap?
shawn: initiating manual rollback to control now. +1. cc @sre-oncall for infra watch
sre-oncall: got it — monitoring infra, no anomalies on GPUs/hosts.
maya: follow-up proposal: allow per-slice variance estimator override and a weighted z metric. low-effort config example:
```
canary_policy.slice_overrides.longdoc:
  variance_estimator: effective_sample_size
  z_threshold: 2.0
  min_samples: 1000
```
ev an: sounds good. recommend running the updated policy in staging for a 2h smoke before re-promote.
olivia: filing PR now: #4521 with config change + unit tests for ESS estimator.
maya: thanks — will monitor the staging run and re-run A/B after 2h smoke. :thumbsup:
shawn: add a dashboard alert for cross-slice variance mismatch so next time bot can explain why stability failed.
maya: adding to infra backlog and tagging oncall for dashboards.
canary-bot: NOTE: run 1761122334 closed (manual rollback by shawn). log: /runs/1761122334/rollback-log
maya: closing loop here. will post final numbers after staging smoke.
